description:
Add Jetpack Compose support to the existing Views-based 'ViewsApp' project and create a new Compose screen.

1. Configure the build system in `app/build.gradle.kts`:
   - Enable Compose in `buildFeatures` (`compose = true`)
   - Set `composeOptions` with `kotlinCompilerExtensionVersion = "1.5.1"`
   - Add the Compose BOM: `platform("androidx.compose:compose-bom:2024.02.00")`
   - Add dependencies: `ui`, `ui-graphics`, `ui-tooling-preview`, `material3`, `activity-compose`, and `ui-tooling` (debug)

2. Create a new file `app/src/main/java/com/example/viewsapp/ui/ProfileScreen.kt`:
   - Add a `@Composable` function named `ProfileScreen`
   - It should display a user profile (e.g., Name, Email) using Material3 components
   - Add a `@Preview` function

3. Create a new Activity `app/src/main/java/com/example/viewsapp/ProfileActivity.kt`:
   - It must extend `ComponentActivity`
   - In `onCreate`, use `setContent { ... }` to display `ProfileScreen()`

4. Register the new `ProfileActivity` in `AndroidManifest.xml`.

5. Verify the project builds successfully by running `./gradlew assembleDebug` or using Build > Make Project.
